run_actor_demo: run the ai4animation actor demo program that loads a glb model and rotates it over time
create_actor_entity: create an actor entity in the ai4animation scene by adding a glb model component with bone names
set_entity_rotation: set an entity's rotation using euler angles that change over total elapsed time
sync_actor_from_scene: sync the actor component state from the scene to keep animation data up to date
run_standalone_mode: run the ai4animation engine in standalone mode with a custom program class that has start and update methods
